detections.summary: Speaker rebuts a viral edited video clip that misrepresents Bill Gates' comments on vaccination as profiteering, explaining the original point was about humanitarian and economic benefits of vaccination.
Speaker corrects a widely-circulated, deceptively edited video clip about Bill Gates and vaccines.

detections.evidence_quote: we feel there's been over a twenty-to-one return
detections.summary: Playback of Bill Gates' remarks describing a roughly 20-to-1 economic return on vaccine investments through Gavi and related global-health funds, framed as saving millions of lives.

detections.evidence_quote: There's this weird narrative, there's this weird meme, there's this weird conspiracy that Bill Gates is some.
detections.summary: Hosts reject a circulating narrative that Bill Gates promotes vaccines purely to profit, calling it a conspiracy theory.

detections.evidence_quote: Fucking demon that just wants to make money off of vaccines, and he's pushing vaccines.
detections.summary: Hosts describe and dismiss the conspiracy narrative that Gates secretly profits from pushing vaccines.

verification_candidates.claim_text: The Gates Foundation invested $10 billion in vaccinations over the last two decades.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: You've invested $10 billion in vaccinations over the last two decades
verification_candidates.rationale: A specific, checkable funding figure central to the disputed video clip.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Global vaccine investment has produced over a 20-to-1 economic return.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: we feel there's been over a twenty-to-one return
verification_candidates.rationale: A specific economic-return figure attributed to vaccine investment that can be checked.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Vaccination investment through low-cost, high-volume delivery has saved millions of lives.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: You literally save millions of lives.
verification_candidates.rationale: A specific claim about lives saved by vaccination programs that can be checked against health data.

verification_candidates.claim_text: Bill Gates promotes vaccines mainly to profit from them.
verification_candidates.evidence_quote: Fucking demon that just wants to make money off of vaccines, and he's pushing vaccines.
verification_candidates.rationale: This widely circulated conspiracy claim about Gates' motives warrants checking against his stated and actual vaccine funding record.
